completed_range_statement: Family I: complete (86047/86047 candidates checked, exhaustive). Family II: incomplete as of this manifest; results will be appended once the sharded search finishes.

family_i.conclusion: Family I (2,3^18) is empty: 86047/86047 candidates contain a C8. Four independent detectors agree (Python DFS, networkx, C from-scratch DFS unit-tested separately, SAT encoding validated on synthetic trials).

sat_cross_validation.note: sat_ham_path_from vs has_ham_path_from: 200 random trials, 0 disagreements. sat_cycle_len_exists vs DFS+networkx: 100 trials x {C4,C8}, 0 disagreements. Synthetic validation of the SAT encodings themselves, not run exhaustively over all 86047 candidates (unnecessary once stage-1 C8/C16 already eliminates 100% of candidates by two other independent detectors plus the C implementation).

current_search.method: geng res/mod 4-way sharding, each shard streamed through verifier/type_b_slack_degree_filter.py to discard non-matching-degree graphs without storing them

family_ii.naive_single_threaded_attempt: timeout 300 nauty-geng -c -q -f -d2 -D4 19 28:28 -u did not complete (SIGTERM, exit 143)
family_ii.prefix_inspection: first 8287530 graphs generated by an unsharded run (subsequently stopped) contained zero matches for the exact 2^2,3^16,4 degree profile; not used as evidence of absence
family_ii.reason_geng_direct_generation_infeasible: nauty-geng only supports global min/max degree bounds (-d/-D), not exact per-vertex degree counts. The -d2 -D4 19 28:28 box includes every degree profile with deviation-from-3 summing to -1, not just the 2^2,3^16,4 profile (ruled in by Section 1 of type_b_one_slack_resolution.md but not distinguishable to geng).
family_ii.status: IN PROGRESS - not complete as of this manifest version

scope_honesty: Family I fully eliminated by exhaustive four-detector computation. Family II search is INCOMPLETE as of this manifest version; no elimination or survival claim is made for it. |V(G)|>=40 is NOT claimed.
